name: Hotel Austria
beschreibung: The Hotel Austria welcomes guests to the heart of the idyllic village of Söll at Dorf 10 in the Wilder Kaiser holiday region in Tyrol. This traditional establishment provides comfortable alpine-style rooms and suites complete with contemporary en-suite bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing views of the Hohe Salve and the rugged Wilder Kaiser cliffs. To unwind after an active day outdoors, the spacious spa area featuring an indoor swimming pool, Finnish sauna, steam room, and relaxation lounge invites guests to rest. Each morning features a wholesome breakfast buffet laden with regional delicacies, followed by authentic Tyrolean dinners in the rustic parlour. The base gondola terminal of the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental is reached in just minutes via the complimentary ski bus stopping right at the property. Summer delivers themed adventures like Hexenwasser.
kurzbeschreibung: Centrally located hotel at Dorf 10 in Söll at the Wilder Kaiser with an indoor pool, saunas, and swift access to the SkiWelt.
